Cacklerot changes the situation more than the damage math - range is Close with a Focus duration.

GMs: Use Cacklerot on a level 4 or lower creature to incapacitate a key threat, maintaining focus for maximum impact.

Daily tabletop RPG rulings. Follow @bizzalgames70 for one a day.

Gorgon's AC is higher than expected for its challenge rating - 19 from natural armor.

DMs: Use the Gorgon's 40-foot movement against it by bottlenecking it in tight spaces, then focus fire to overcome its 114 hit points.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Blade of Great Strength seems like a permanent boost - its +4 Strength bonus vanishes the moment it leaves.

Judges: Remind players that the Blade of Great Strength's +4 bonus vanishes if it's not in their hand.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Patron Bond and Invoke Patron can surprise players with its long-term consequences - patron taint accumulates.

Judges: Track each patron bond attempt and taint accumulation; it'll save you from future "I didn't know" arguments.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Advantage and Disadvantage confuse players more than they expect - multiple sources don't stack.

GMs: Roll twice for Advantage or Disadvantage, pick the result, and ignore any stacking nonsense - this isn't a debate club.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

The Celestial's spell list offers healing and radiant damage options - guiding bolt and cure wounds.

DMs: Allocate spell slots wisely; save revivify for boss fights and use cantrips or cure wounds in routine skirmishes.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Make Rot Flower cost something.

GMs: Slip a Rot Flower into combat when they're distracted; its DC 12 toxin will remind them why focus matters.

Hazards often trigger more than once - they apply effects each time conditions are met.

DMs: Clarify that hazards like burning trigger each time conditions are met, as per Rules Glossary, to avoid repeated disputes.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Vermin Blight changes the battlefield dynamics more than players expect - 200' + 10' per caster level range.

Judges: Use Vermin Blight's 200' + 10' per level range to force enemy movement, not just rack up damage.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Cloak Of Elvenkind's invisibility is more limited than players assume - it lasts only 5 rounds and ends if you.

GMs: Remind them the cloak's invisibility lasts 5 rounds; use it for stealthy retreats, not mid-battle vanishing acts.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Judges: Exploit its -3 initiative; let the players act first and leverage cold or water for double damage.
